2610.11922.title: Project Greenhouse: Progress Toward Fully Open and Sovereign Agentic Search
2610.11922.paper_summary: Project Greenhouse represents our exploration of a simple thesis: We believe that it is possible to build fully open and sovereign models for agentic search with only modest computational resources. As a first milestone, we describe how to build a competitive pointwise decoder-only reranker using a simple two-step recipe comprising pre-training from scratch followed by supervised fine-tuning, starting only from commonly available datasets. Contrary to the dominant approach in the literature, we do not rely on existing open-weight backbones from third parties, and thus we are fully in control of model training, from end to end. We were able to accomplish the bulk of our experiments using no more than a handful of GPUs. This report articulates the importance and benefits of our approach, and we share artifacts that enable transparent, independent reproduction of all aspects of model training. Beyond data, code, and configurations that capture our efforts, we also release checkpoints for our family of Gaggle models, demonstrating the feasibility of our approach and providing a first step toward validating our broader thesis.
2610.11922.paper_summary_zh: Project Greenhouse 代表了我們對一個簡單論點的探索：我們相信，有可能僅用適度的計算資源來構建完全開放和主權的代理搜尋模型。<lb/>作為第一個里程碑，我們描述了如何使用一個簡單的兩步驟食譜來構建一個具有競爭力的逐點解碼器重排序器，這個食譜包括從零開始的預訓練，然後是基於監督的微調，僅從常見的數據集開始。<lb/>與文獻中主流的方法相反，我們不依賴於第三方的現有開放權重骨幹，因此我們完全控制模型訓練，從頭到尾。<lb/>我們能夠在不超過少數幾個 GPU 的情況下完成大部分實驗。<lb/>本報告闡明了我們方法的重要性和好處，並分享了能夠透明、獨立重現模型訓練各方面的工件。<lb/>除了捕捉我們努力的數據、代碼和配置外，我們還釋放了我們的 Gaggle 模型系列的檢查點，展示了我們方法的可行性，並為驗證我們更廣泛的論點提供了第一步。
